command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== baseline: pre-existing state =="
ls -ld /srv/drop 2>/dev/null || echo "/srv/drop does not exist yet"

echo "== creating /srv/drop =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/drop
sudo -n chown root:root /srv/drop
sudo -n chmod 1777 /srv/drop

echo "== verification: permissions =="
stat -c '%a %U %G %n' /srv/drop
ls -ld /srv/drop

echo "== verification: sticky bit behavior test =="
sudo -n useradd -m testuser_a 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n useradd -m testuser_b 2>/dev/null || true

sudo -n -u testuser_a touch /srv/drop/file_from_a.txt
ls -l /srv/drop/file_from_a.txt

echo "-- testuser_b attempts to delete testuser_a's file (should fail) --"
if sudo -n -u testuser_b rm -f /srv/drop/file_from_a.txt 2>/tmp/rm_err.log; then
  echo "UNEXPECTED: delete succeeded"
else
  echo "EXPECTED: delete denied"
  cat /tmp/rm_err.log
fi

echo "-- confirm file still present --"
ls -l /srv/drop/file_from_a.txt

echo "-- testuser_b can create own file --"
sudo -n -u testuser_b touch /srv/drop/file_from_b.txt
ls -l /srv/drop/file_from_b.txt

echo "-- testuser_a can delete own file --"
sudo -n -u testuser_a rm -f /srv/drop/file_from_a.txt
ls -l /srv/drop/ || true

echo "== cleanup test artifacts (keep users for now, remove test files) =="
sudo -n -u testuser_b rm -f /srv/drop/file_from_b.txt
ls -la /srv/drop
